text:
liam: FYI observed repeated nvme CRC errors on gnode-usw2-03..06 during today's provisioning ramp. GPU attach timeouts and a bunch of retries.

sophia: logs?

liam: paste logs:
```
[ 1234.567890] nvme0: crc error namespace 1 lba 0x1fa3f
[ 1234.567895] nvme0: ctrl failing - reset required
[ 1234.568001] attach timeout: device attach failed for /dev/nvme0n1
```

matt: looks like firmware 2.1.5 was applied last deploy window. vendor changelog mentions checksum tightening — plausible regression.

infra-bot: ALERT: nvme-controller crc errors > threshold on 4 nodes (gnode-usw2-03..06)

arya: mitigation options: 1) rollback fw to 2.1.4, 2) throttle gpu provisioning (smaller batch window), 3) tag nodes not to auto-upgrade images.

eng-oncall: I'm going to canary drain gnode-usw2-03 and reboot with fw 2.1.4 image; ETA 18m. Will post status.

liam: also, these attach failures are triggering retries in autoscaler which launches extra GPUs — cost spike. rough number: ~120 GPU-min wasted so far.

sophia: vendor ticket opened (VND-12345). They recommend rollback for affected tank. Also checking kernel nvme timeout param but prefer to revert.

matt: rollout plan in ops doc: `1) tag nodes drained 2) scale down autoscaler to 0.5x 3) apply fw rollback 4) smoke test attach 5) un-drain`

liam: please add a temporary policy to prevent image fw auto-upgrades until vendor patch verifies.

sophia: added tag `fw-rollback-needed` and updated runbook in /runbooks/nvme-fw.json. also adding alert to cost channel for retry storms.

eng-oncall: canary done on 03 -> error rate dropped ~92%, attach latency back to baseline. proceeding in 5-node batches.

matt: coordinating with scheduler to window next batches off-peak. expecting full remediation in ~2h.

liam: thanks. after stable, let's add a postmortem: root cause analysis + cost tally.

arya: logging action items:
- rollback firmware on affected pools
- prevent auto-fw in images
- tune autoscaler retry backoff
- add metric for nvme crc->gpu-alloc correlation

liam: :thumbsup:
